== Published English Original Virtual Set 4 wording ==
Both deploy on a just-deployed opponent Maintenance card. The original recurring alternative occurs during the opponent’s draw phase and puts the card out of play if the loss is unpaid. The later source adds an extra Maintenance cost and its printed loss/sacrifice alternatives. Initial loss/retrieval, power reduction, ability restriction and Control immunity remain.
